display_long_description:
Portal Rush is an innovative VR runner game that immerses you in a thrilling, fast-paced world. Your objective is to race through obstacle-filled courses, react quickly, and achieve the highest score possible.

What makes Portal Rush unique is its portal-based movement mechanic. With a simple click, you can open portals and instantly teleport to different locations throughout each course. This mechanic keeps every run fast and exciting while also requiring you to think ahead, choose the right moment to teleport, and plan your movements carefully.

Each level introduces progressively more challenging tracks designed to test your reflexes, timing, and decision-making skills. As you advance, you can collect points, improve your scores, climb the leaderboard, and compete with other players.

Immersive VR gameplay and dynamic visual effects make every course feel intense and engaging. Whether you are trying to beat your personal best or aiming for the top of the leaderboard, every run offers a new opportunity to improve your skills.

Portal Rush delivers a fast and energetic experience for VR enthusiasts and fans of runner games. Open portals, overcome obstacles, race through challenging courses, and push your reflexes to the limit. Every run brings a new challenge and a new adventure!
